news.title: Telecom stocks wobble after report SpaceX is in talks for at least 80,000 cell sites
news.summary: Bloomberg reported late Thursday that SpaceX is negotiating access to at least 80,000 U.S. cell sites, including with Crown Castle, to build a fourth nationwide wireless carrier. AT&T fell 5.6%, T-Mobile 5% and Verizon 1.6%, while Crown Castle jumped 11.6%; Bernstein said the competitive impact may be years away. SPCX rose 1.9% to $147.49.

news.title: Musk's public endorsement of a SpaceX–Tesla deal may throw a wrench in talks
news.summary: Musk's comments about a potential $3.5 trillion combination rattled some insiders, who worry it could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks, a source said. Talks are early; SpaceX approached Tesla in recent weeks, and structures under discussion include a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla or a new holding company, possibly all-stock.

news.title: Silicon Valley Democrats demand probe of Starlink restrictions in Ukraine
news.summary: House Democrats asked the White House to investigate the throttling of Starshield, the military version of Starlink, in Ukraine; Ukrainian officials said speed limits on drone-mounted receivers remained despite President Trump saying service was restored. The letter signals scrutiny of federal funding for Musk's companies if Democrats win the House on Nov. 3.

news.title: SpaceX declines three Space Force launch contracts; Starship Flight 15 targeted for November
news.summary: Citing Politico, Ars reports SpaceX declined to bid on three National Security Space Launch missions as it stops signing new Falcon 9/Falcon Heavy contracts. Shotwell said SpaceX expects the Flight 15 license to include return-to-launch-site tower catches of both stages; Musk disputed a NASA safety panel estimate of about 22 refuelings for a lunar landing, saying 6 to 8.

news.title: With earnings done, SpaceX–Tesla merger chatter takes center stage
news.summary: A tie-up faces negotiations, shareholder votes and U.S. and foreign regulatory reviews; Musk said Tesla would need a 50% vote of all shares. William Blair called the push about control rather than a material opportunity, while former Tesla director Steve Westly expects a proposal quickly, ideally before the midterms. SpaceX's 9% drop put it back below its post-debut opening price.

news.title: SpaceX falls 9.1% to $144.75 as up to 1.3B shares unlock and the tech selloff resumes
news.summary: The largest lock-up tranche yet (28% of the 180-day pool, about 9.7% of shares outstanding) became sellable Thursday; SPCX gave back Wednesday's 7.8% post-earnings pop on about 194M shares, weighed by Q4 capex guidance of $35–40B. Another 328.4M shares become tradable Monday, Oct. 26, and about 797.6M on Dec. 8; Musk's shares stay locked until June 2027.

news.title: Steep bill for the AI buildout punishes Meta, SpaceX and other tech favorites
news.summary: Meta fell 7% after announcing a new share class to help fund AI spending, SpaceX declined 9% and Nvidia 4%, and the Nasdaq Composite lost 2.6%, its biggest drop since June 5, as Lam Research's 12% plunge dragged the chip index down 6.7%.

news.title: Musk's public endorsement of a SpaceX–Tesla deal may delay talks, sources say
news.summary: Musk's disclosure of the merger talks rattled some insiders, who worry it could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks; one person called it a "mess". Advisers have been hired, SpaceX approached Tesla in recent weeks, and structures under discussion include a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla or a merger under a new holding company, possibly all-stock.

news.title: SpaceX and Tesla slide premarket as up to 1.3B SpaceX shares unlock today
news.summary: SPCX traded about 3% lower and TSLA about 5% lower in early premarket trading Thursday, the day the largest lock-up tranche (up to 1.3B shares, 28% of the main lock-up pool) becomes free to sell; another 328M follow on Oct. 24 and the main lock-up ends Dec. 8.

news.title: SpaceX closes up 7.8% at $159.31 after its Q3 beat and merger talk
news.summary: Shares rose 7.79% on Wednesday on about 221M shares traded (intraday range $156.93–$166.18) after a $4.4B quarterly profit, with the Super Intelligence segment more than half of revenue. Space ETFs and Rocket Lab rose with it; QQQ gained 1.1%.

news.title: Analysts lift SpaceX targets after Q3: JPMorgan to $500, Barclays $300, Wells Fargo $274
news.summary: JPMorgan raised its target to $500 from $240, Barclays to $300 from $254, Wells Fargo to $274 from $214, Citi to $240 from $200 and UBS to $230 from $210; Morgan Stanley kept $300 and HSBC stayed at Hold with a $150 target. Consumer Starlink subscribers rose 1.6M to 13.6M in the quarter.

news.title: SpaceX reports Q3 2026: revenue $14.6B (+161%), first profit as a public company
news.summary: Revenue rose 161% to $14.6B from $5.6B, with income from operations of $2.8B, net income of $4.4B (vs a $1.1B loss a year earlier) and adjusted EBITDA of $8.8B (+306%). Connectivity revenue grew 69%; nameplate compute reached 1.7 GW at Sept. 30, and the first revenue-generating Starship mission delivered 26 Starlink V3 satellites.
